issue.title: vcs_finalize_commit push failure records no unpushed-commit marker, unlike vcs_create_commit
issue.description:
A stitch resumed after conflict repair that commits locally but fails to push records no unpushed-commit marker, unlike the fresh-commit path, so the commit finalizer's unpushed-resume recovery lane cannot see the landed commit.

Found during a builtin commit-finalizer conflict-repair turn (2026-09-08, workspace sase_18): after resolving a rebase conflict and running `git rebase --continue`, `sase stitch create --resume` reached `finalize_commit`, the push to origin was rejected (`receive.denyCurrentBranch`: origin primary checkout had `master` checked out), and `commit_results.json` was never written in `$SASE_ARTIFACTS_DIR`. The paused checkpoint (`commit_state.json`) does survive because the resume returns FAILED before `checkpoint_delete()`, but the finalizer's `_resume_unpushed_already_clean_repos` lane in `src/sase/finalizers/commit.py` keys off unpushed markers via `_load_commit_results(artifacts)`, so a clean-tree repo with a locally landed-but-unpushed resumed commit presents no marker evidence to that recovery lane.

Root cause: commit 77b7e5ea0 ("fix(workspace): harden clone origins and push recovery") added `_record_unpushed_commit_marker` / `_format_unpushed_commit_failure` and wired them into `vcs_create_commit`'s push-failure return, but `vcs_finalize_commit`'s push-failure return was left as a bare `(False, err)`.

Likely fix shape: have `vcs_finalize_commit` route its push failure through `_format_unpushed_commit_failure(payload, cwd, err)` as `vcs_create_commit` does, and verify the marker + retained checkpoint interact sanely (no double resume attempt, no duplicate ledger identity) with the finalizer's unpushed-resume lane.

task_type_fields.impact: The finalizer's _resume_unpushed_already_clean_repos recovery lane keys off unpushed markers, so a resumed commit that lands locally but cannot push is invisible to it; recovery then depends solely on the retained commit_state.json checkpoint and manual retries
task_type_fields.repro: Pause a stitch mid-rebase (conflict), resolve, git rebase --continue, then run 'sase stitch create --resume' against an origin that rejects the push (e.g. receive.denyCurrentBranch with the branch checked out): the commit lands locally, resume prints 'finalize_commit failed: git push failed after rebase retries', and no commit_results.json unpushed marker is written in SASE_ARTIFACTS_DIR

payload.description: Adjacent finalizer-retry gap: sase-xi resumes pending hook-failure steps on retry; this bug leaves the unpushed-resume lane blind to a resumed commit whose push failed — fixes touch the same commit_state/commit_results recovery surface
Same family of unowned failed-push commit: sase-ye strands artifact-link index commits after one push attempt; this bug strands a resumed main-repo commit without the marker the recovery lane needs
